the risk of readmission to the hospital after a childhood asthma admission is high, especially for those children who are admitted to the hospital for the first time.
the use of asthma medication is a risk factor for readmissions for asthma, even after accounting for the severity of asthma and other factors.

the number of children who are admitted to hospitals for asthma is increasing, and the rate of readmission for asthma is decreasing, which suggests that we may be getting better at treating this disease.
